sources.snippet: This report describes a generic virtual synchronous machine (VSM) grid-forming inverter (GFM) model—REGFM_B1. The initial model specification was proposed by Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), General Electric (GE), and Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI).
